test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Gymnast Pranati Nayak, who has qualified for the 2021 Tokyo Olympics after winning Asian quota, is from which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Gymnast Pranati Nayak belongs to West Bengal and has qualified for the 2021 Tokyo Olympics after winning the Asian quota.
 
• Gymnast Pranati Nayak will get the continental quota to compete in the Tokyo Olympic Games.
 
• Since the Asian Championship has been cancelled due to the Covid pandemic, the unused continental quotas will be reallocated to the eligible athletes from the Asian zone only.
 
• Sri Lankan Elpitiya Badalge Dona Milka Geh is the first reserve for the Asian quota while Pranati is the second reserve.
